# ModePot

> ModePot is an open-source family of focused Python frameworks created by Tugrul Guner. The family currently includes Dexpot, Intpot, and Summonpot.

ModePot is not one platform. Each project owns a separate software boundary:

- [Dexpot](https://github.com/tugrulguner/dexpot): A synchronous Python API framework that compiles routes and adapts execution to standard GIL or free-threaded CPython.
- [Intpot](https://github.com/tugrulguner/intpot): A Python framework that serves typed tools as Typer CLIs, FastAPI applications, or FastMCP servers and converts existing applications between those interfaces.
- [Summonpot](https://github.com/tugrulguner/summonpot): A contract-first Python framework for executable API endpoints that combine deterministic application operations with explicitly bounded agent-owned decisions.

## Primary resources

- [ModePot homepage](https://modepot.io/): Family overview and project comparison.
- [ModePot source](https://github.com/tugrulguner/modepot): Source for the family website.
- [ModePot community](https://discord.gg/u3AANZr6RG): Discord for project discussion.

## Selection guide

Use Dexpot to build synchronous Python HTTP APIs with interpreter-adaptive execution.
Use Intpot to expose or translate typed tools across CLI, HTTP API, and MCP interfaces.
Use Summonpot to define typed API contracts whose agent-owned decisions are limited to declared application capabilities.
